projects.name: GoLab - Sandboxed Go Code Execution Playground
projects.description: Browser-to-container code execution playground for GolangForAll. Isolated compilation and execution in separate Docker containers with no network, non-root users, resource limits, and cached builds.
highlights: Launched GoLab for 60+ users in GolangForAll’s 80+ member WhatsApp community: Next.js/Monaco frontend, Go runner on AWS EC2.
Isolated compilation and execution in separate Docker containers with no network, non-root users and resource limits.
Used read-only container root filesystems and cached compiler builds; mounted the runtime workspace read-only.
Created GolangForAll’s Docusaurus platform for 200+ users with Go APIs, Neon PostgreSQL and Cloudinary.
projects.impact: Created a live, publicly accessible sandboxed Go execution environment engineered for hostile workloads.

projects.name: VartaLang - Language Exchange and LMS
projects.description: Language exchange and learning platform featuring real-time chat, reciprocal multilingual matching across 33 languages, LMS with Razorpay payment processing, and Sarvam AI Indic translation & TTS integrations.
highlights: Engineered VartaLang microservices with Node.js/Express, MongoDB and Socket.IO for reciprocal matching and real-time chat; deployed at api.vartalang.in with GitHub Actions checks. Reached 60+ sign-ups and 500+ visitors.

Launched learn.vartalang.in with freemium courses in 33 languages, instructor onboarding, sales reports and live Razorpay; implemented SSO between VartaLang and the LMS, with shared MongoDB user accounts and LMS data in Neon PostgreSQL.
Added Sarvam Translate and Google Cloud translation APIs for Indic and foreign-language chat, plus Sarvam Bulbul TTS, read receipts, blocking, reporting and per-user soft deletion.
Marked 7-day job listings as expired with node-cron; public queries also check the expiry date.
Kept expired listings in the admin panel for manual paid extensions, then automated cleanup with MongoDB TTL.
Selected for the Sarvam Startup Program; advanced to RideHack JIIT Round 2 for funding.
projects.impact: Combined language exchange, real-time messaging, reciprocal matching, and LMS course monetization into a production platform.

projects.name: Cosmo India Prakashan - E-Commerce and AI Inventory Platform
projects.description: AI-powered publishing and e-commerce platform for a family publishing house with polyglot persistence, cryptographic Razorpay payment verification, and staff-reviewed Gemini product catalog workflows.
highlights: Deployed a live storefront on Vercel with serverless APIs and MongoDB orders; verified Razorpay payments with HMAC-SHA256 and served 400+ visits.
Designed an Express admin API with JWT RBAC and polyglot persistence: PostgreSQL inventory and MongoDB orders; added staff-reviewed Gemini product entry.
projects.impact: Transformed a traditional publishing business into an active digital storefront with cryptographic payment verification and an AI-assisted operational layer.
